t: The Woman in Black 2: Angel of Death
d: Forty years after Arthur Kipps investigated the first haunting, two teachers and some refugee children take shelter in Eel Marsh House, awakening the dark spirit that lurks there.
A teen (Kristen Stewart) and her younger brother desperately try to warn their disbelieving family about ominous apparitions that only the children see.
Some friends think a new Website is just a hoax with a clever marketing campaign until everyone who logs on dies.
An unemployed writer rises to the top of the financial world after an experimental drug gives him extraordinary mental acuity.
A mild-mannered college professor (Jake Gyllenhaal) discovers a look-alike actor and delves into the other man's private affairs.
A veteran detective and a rookie cop have to stop a master thief's computer virus before it drains all the funds from a bank's accounts.
A New Yorker (Michael Biehn) heads to California to find the look-alike brother (James Coburn) of his con-man father.
Two unseen scientists manipulate the gory goings-on at a backwoods cabin inhabited by a group of unsuspecting college friends (Kristen Connolly, Chris Hemsworth, Anna Hutchison).
A Wall Street banker connects a small-town art gallery to a global conspiracy, putting his own family in grave danger.
A former bounty hunter (Randy Orton) lands in a tournament where convicts fight to the death for an online audience.
